title: Wizard at Work
description: A bald man in a blue robe covered with marks sits at a black desk and writes with a quill in his right hand while his left hand touches a glowing blue shape on the paper. The room has stone walls covered with papers that have marks and runes painted on them, a window showing green light in the sky, and tables filled with a compass, magnifying glass, jars, and plants.
prompt: A bald man wearing a dark blue robe with white marks sits at a large black desk facing away from the viewer. His right hand holds a large quill pen writing on paper while his left hand touches a glowing blue shape on the page. Floating papers covered in painted marks and runes burn with purple flames above him. Stone walls hold many pinned papers with drawings. A window on the left shows green aurora in the night sky. Tables hold a brass compass, magnifying glass, glass jars with glowing contents, and green plants. Mystical atmosphere with green smoke.
